Method of Attack: remote code execution (RCE) without authentication exploiting outdated Apache Santuario dependency in ManageEngine products with SAML-based single-sign-on enabled
Impacted Systems: ManageEngine products including ServiceDesk Plus and Endpoint Central
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated remote exploitation via vulnerable third-party dependency in ManageEngine products with SAML-based SSO enabled
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise (IOCs) shared by Horizon3 researchers
